blocks.text: 19. Phase Boundary and Next Authorized Work

Phase 1 ends with extraction, reconciliation, documentation, and validation. It does not authorize invention of missing roots, broad compound expansion, a general English parser, finished glyph art, or a translator.

After review and approval, the next nine-root block is MOV:100–122, covering Motion-family processes. Each new block must be generated provisionally, validated, reviewed by the user, and only then marked canonical.
End of Era Zero Phase 1 canonical language reference.
